name: Slag hound
description: the Magma King's hunting dog: a lean wolf-like hound of black cooled slag, molten orange lava glowing along its spine and in the cracks of its ribs, long legs, a narrow head with burning yellow eyes and a glowing maw, smoke curling off its back, four legs on the ground

poses.stand: standing on all four legs side-on, head low, lava glowing along its back
poses.struck: just hit and recoiling, eyes wide, mouth open, body jolted back, sparks and chips flying off it
poses.dead: breaking apart in a burst of black soot, grey ash and orange embers

idle.action: stands panting on all fours, smoke curling off its glowing back

move.action: trots forward on all four legs, lava pulsing along its back, staying in the same spot in the frame

attack.action: crouches low, then lunges forward to the right with its jaws wide open, then pulls up

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with a pained grimace, then recovers

die.action: flares bright and breaks apart into soot, ash and embers
